lessons: Nov 20: Theo's morning bonus (a short 'real life' moment, 6 AM gym) got the first shares on any account (2). Try more small in-between moments.

Nov 20: votes are near zero on every account (Theo 2, Malik 0, Rosie 0, Horde 0 hauls). Test stronger, easier vote asks (fewer options, a clear 'comment 1 or 2' A/B) and see which account's wording gets more comments.
Nov 20 (1h data): new retention format lowered skip rate on every account that used it (Theo 55.8%->45.6%, Malik 66.3%->48.8%, Horde 58%->53.1%). Keep it everywhere.
Nov 20: only Theo has followers (21). Stories/images/carousels reach ~nobody yet; growth = Reels to non-followers.
Nov 20 analysis: viewers leave during the stats panel/scoreboard at 9-17 s; the vote (29-39 s) is almost never seen. Use template v3 (20-28 s, vote by 18 s).
Nov 20 analysis: hooks that start with 'Day N: you voted' lose ~50-70% in 3 s. Open on the most dramatic beat.

Nov 21 AM extras: Horde fact #1 (v3, 27 s) 114 views / 0 engagement after ~10 h vs battle Reels 108-156 views: same reach, no comments either way. Theo bonus: kept the single-moment format (best % watched + only shares), 27 s, vote by 18 s.

Nov 21 midday extras: Horde fact #3 had only 3 views ~30 min after posting while battle D3 (posted 13 min later) had 85 and fact #2 181 -> possibly two Horde Reels 13 min apart split/suppressed distribution; keep 60+ min between Horde Reels. Compare its comments/views vs fact and battle Reels next run.
